cards.front: Recall a key point about Polar Coordinates
cards.back: x = r cos θ, y = r sin θ; r = sqrt(x^2+y^2), tan θ = y/x (check quadrant)

cards.front: Recall a key point about Polar Coordinates
cards.back: r = a (circle centred at origin), r = 2a cos θ (circle on x-axis), r = 2a sin θ (circle on y-axis)

cards.front: Recall a key point about Polar Coordinates
cards.back: r = a(1 + cos θ) (cardioid), r = a cos(nθ) (n-petal rose if n odd, 2n-petal if n even)

cards.front: Recall a key point about Polar Coordinates
cards.back: r = aθ (Archimedean spiral), r^2 = a^2 cos 2θ (lemniscate)

cards.front: Recall a key point about Polar Coordinates
cards.back: Area = ½∫_{α}^{β} r^2 dθ; Area between curves = ½∫(r₁^2 - r₂^2) dθ

cards.front: Recall a key point about Polar Coordinates
cards.back: Tangents: dy/dθ = sin θ dr/dθ + r cos θ, dx/dθ = cos θ dr/dθ - r sin θ; dy/dx = (dy/dθ)/(dx/dθ)

cards.front: Recall a key point about Polar Coordinates
cards.back: Horizontal tangent: dy/dθ = 0 (r cos θ + sin θ dr/dθ = 0); Vertical: dx/dθ = 0
